vector_memory.semantic_summary: This utility module provides a comprehensive abstraction layer for core system interactions, bridging high-level logic with OS operations. It manages file I/O (reading, writing, path resolution), console management (clearing, setting title), and sophisticated logging infrastructure. It is critical for standardizing application behavior, handling system information retrieval, and ensuring robust error handling across the application stack.
